stock.counterargument: The honest counterargument is the sample: this process has not been shown to work, and a single ranking position is not evidence about one company.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below +138.8%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $88.16 on the decision date.
risks: The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-11-03, 13 days before the decision date.
One of the four quarters in the trailing year is the fourth quarter, which companies report only as part of the full year; it is derived as the annual figure less the first three quarters.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-11-16.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2026-02-26) plus 364 days

stock.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
stock.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Understanding Python Namespace Packages.

By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit what namespace packages are, how they differ from regular packages, and why they’re a good fit for large collections of related packages. You’ll also review how Python combines same-named folders into one namespace, how to configure uv to build a namespace package, and how to publish its members to TestPyPI and install them independently.

This is an advanced topic, so it helps to be comfortable with Python’s import system and the basics of packaging.

stories.title: Mozambique opposition leader faces trial over deadly 2024 election unrest
stories.excerpt: Venâncio Mondlane faces several charges over 2024 post-election protests that left hundreds of people dead.
stories.lead:
Tensions are running high in Mozambique's capital, Maputo, with a heavy police deployment as a prominent opposition leader goes on trial over deadly protests that followed the country's disputed 2024 elections.

Venâncio Mondlane faces several charges, including incitement to terrorism and civil disobedience, over protests that left hundreds of people dead. He denies any wrongdoing.

Security has been tightened around the Supreme Court, where Mondlane is due to appear on Tuesday, with authorities fearing a fresh wave of demonstrations by his supporters.

stories.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
stories.excerpt: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.
stories.lead:
COLUMBUS, Ohio — A few miles south of The Ohio State University, Ashley Baukman is wrestling with a piece of steel tubing, using only a manual tool called a foot pedal and her sheer strength to bend it 90 degrees.

This class in conduit bending at The Electrical Trades Center of Central Ohio is part of an apprenticeship program Baukman began in the spring. She's here in class one day out of every two weeks. Other days, she's out on construction sites, working under the supervision of journeymen electricians.

For the 36-year-old college graduate and licensed social worker, it's a new chapter — one she hopes will be the foundation of a long-term career.

Google became one of the most valuable companies in the world by revolutionizing how humanity finds information. stories.title: Speed camera fault may have allowed drivers to escape fines
stories.excerpt: The Home Office has revoked approval that allowed footage from speed cameras to be used in evidence.
stories.lead:
Further problems with the accuracy of speed cameras on English roads have been uncovered which may have allowed thousands of drivers to slip through the cracks and escape fines.

National Highways discovered issues with how speed cameras were activated last year, affecting 154 out of 400 cameras but, following an investigation, has since detected further faults.

The Home Office has revoked the approval that allows the footage to be used as evidence in legal proceedings. US firm Verra Mobility operates the cameras but National Highways said it would now end its contract with the company.

Former Business Secretary Peter Kyle has said the government must act urgently to "level the playing field" for Royal Mail or risk the business becoming unviable.

He said he was concerned that the firm was being "undercut" by rival parcel delivery firms who did not employ staff under the same conditions.

Royal Mail, which is owned by International Distribution Services, has struggled in recent years with increased competition, fewer letters being sent and fines from the regulator for missing delivery targets.
